movie.title: UFC Fight Night 282: Ankalaev vs. Guskov
movie.originalTitle: UFC Fight Night 282: Ankalaev vs. Guskov
movie.overview: UFC Fight Night 282: Ankalaev vs. Guskov was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on July 25, 2026, at the Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. A light heavyweight bout between former UFC Light Heavyweight Champion Magomed Ankalaev and Bogdan Guskov headlined the event.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Former Light Heavyweight Champion Magomed Ankalaev faces off against rising contender Bogdan Guskov in a high-stakes mixed martial arts showdown at the Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: UFC Fight Night 282 delivers high-octane mixed martial arts action live from the Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. The event is headlined by a pivotal light heavyweight bout between former division champion Magomed Ankalaev and explosive striker Bogdan Guskov. Both fighters enter the Octagon seeking a decisive victory to solidify their place at the top of the 205-pound division. Packed with dramatic finishes and tactical battles, the event showcases top-tier talent from across the globe.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: UFC Fight Night 282 brings elite combat sports back to Abu Dhabi's Etihad Arena for an action-packed night of mixed martial arts. In the main event, former UFC Light Heavyweight Champion Magomed Ankalaev looks to reassert his dominance in the division. Opposite him stands Bogdan Guskov, a dangerous contender eager to claim the biggest victory of his career and propel himself into title contention. As the fight unfolds, Ankalaev utilizes his well-rounded wrestling and methodical striking to control the distance. Guskov responds with high-intensity power strikes, searching for a knockout blow to disrupt the former champion's rhythm. The tense back-and-forth battle highlights the dramatic physical and mental chess match inherent to elite fighting. Throughout the rest of the card, emerging prospects and seasoned veterans compete for divisional rankings and performance bonuses. The atmosphere inside the Etihad Arena reaches a fever pitch as the main event reaches its thrilling conclusion. Ultimately, the event delivers memorable highlights, defining pivotal trajectories for the fighters involved.
